figures.caption: Fig. 1. SPA1 — Sensitivity to spatial encoding. Normalized latent displacement after permuting electrode labels while holding the waveforms fixed (Sid; left) and after breaking the correspondence between signals and their location (Ssig; right).

Fig. 2. SPA2 — Topographic structure across depth. Spearman correlation between off-channel influence and inter-electrode distance. Negative values indicate stronger influence on nearby than distant channels. Results are shown on PhysioNet-MI.

Fig. 3. SPE1 — Information beyond spectral power. Balanced accuracy of linear probes distinguishing clean recordings from IAAFT [22] surrogates on PhysioNet-MI and Siena. Error bars indicate SD from participant-clustered bootstrapping at 200 resamples.

Fig. 4. SPE2 — Sensitivity to narrowband oscillations. Fourway accuracy for identifying the injected delta, theta, alpha, or beta band from the unit-normalized latent displacement, shown against injection power relative to the original band power.
